assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: iOS app icon and sunrise mascot for Wake Me Up, an alarm app where dancing and push-ups start the morning. Primary request: an original adorable sculptural apricot-orange sun character, one round sun with eight rounded short ray petals, small joyful dark cocoa eyes and smile, playful tiny raised arms, tactile matte clay with delicate fine grain. Style: sophisticated contemporary 3D illustration, warm playful editorial design, pleasing soft shadows, striking memorable silhouette. Composition: centered large character occupying 75% of square frame, no frame, no rounded square border, solid very pale warm cream background filling entire square. Color palette: apricot orange and butter yellow, dark plum face, subtle blush cheeks. Lighting: soft sunrise studio glow. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no other objects. Output square high resolution.
